title: Napoleonic/Musket age-inspired single player game?
author: Successful-Panic1655
selftext:
I'm a sucker for Napoleonic era games where you stand in a line firing muskets and maneuvering to outflank the enemy. That said, the modding scene of older games like Total War: Napoleon (NTW) have greatly benefitted with advancement of AI. Total War: Eras mod and Clausewitz: Grand Reforged mod are good examples of AI being used in the modding scene, albeit those mods still need a lot of refinement to work flawlessly.

That said, with the advent of crossover AI games, I was wondering if it was possible for musket-age multiplayer games like War of Rights to be overhauled in order to include bots and mimic something like Mount & Blade Warband: Napoleonic Mod. Would it be more difficult than using AI to overhaul the game engine of like NTW? 

I'm not a dev, but I am taking small steps in making mods for NTW which gave me some sort of itch, hence the question.
